Trust

Built for institutions that take data seriously.

Gestalt is designed from the ground up for the security and compliance requirements of museums, universities, and cultural institutions.

Data Handling

Visitor interaction data is anonymized by default. No personally identifiable information is collected without explicit consent. Session data is never sold, shared with third parties, or used to build individual visitor profiles.

Authentication

All institution dashboard access is protected by Firebase Authentication with role-based access control. Institution administrators can grant, restrict, and revoke staff access at any time from the curator dashboard without contacting Gestalt support.

Storage

Artwork images, audio files, and embeddings are stored in Firebase Storage with per-file access rules. Audio files are served via signed CDN URLs that expire automatically, preventing unauthorized redistribution of institution-owned content.

Compliance

Gestalt is designed to support ADA Title III compliance documentation. Grant report generation is built into the platform, giving institutions the access logs and engagement metrics they need to demonstrate equitable access to funders and regulators.
